decision.reasoning_trace: The customer is looking to buy a mechanical keyboard. The consideration set includes the PWNAGE Ultra Custom Gaming Keyboard (prod_mechanical_keyboards_036), E-Yooso 60% Retro Steampunk Mechanical Gaming Keyboard (prod_mechanical_keyboards_171), Ganss ALT 71 Wireless/Wired 2.4G + USB Mechanical Keyboard (prod_mechanical_keyboards_057), KINESIS USB-A Freestyle Pro Quiet Ergonomic Split Mechanical Keyboard (prod_mechanical_keyboards_194), and Code V3 104-Key Illuminated Mechanical Keyboard (prod_mechanical_keyboards_034). The final choice is the PWNAGE Ultra Custom Gaming Keyboard, due to its high rating (4.1), positive reviews, and features such as customizable RGB lighting and hot-swappable switches.
